what: A deterministic inventory of the exact Git candidate bytes for every API-contract endpoint except the manifest itself.
self_exclusion_rule: The API contract must list the public manifest exactly once. The manifest hashes every other contract endpoint and excludes exactly itself to avoid recursion.
source_rule: Generation and verification consume one captured stage-0 Git index or one named Git tree. They never mix indexed/tree bytes with mutable worktree endpoint bytes.
path_rule: Every endpoint maps exactly to docs/<contract path>; paths are NFC POSIX relative paths, unique under both exact and Unicode casefold identity, and every Git mode is exactly 100644.
ordering_rule: Endpoint entries are ordered by UTF-8 bytes of the public contract path.
claim_boundary: The artifact proves deterministic repository-candidate byte consistency under SHA-256 when its own raw-byte digest is obtained from an independent boundary. It is unsigned and does not authenticate a deployment, prove that multiple hosted requests were atomic, establish source truth or rights, or certify security.
